kb.title: Intermittent VPN: collect context
kb.tags: vpn disconnect 断开 远程
steps: Record the disconnect time and exact client error, without sharing credentials.
Check whether normal internet also drops at that time.
kb.verification: Observe whether the failure affects internet or only VPN.
kb.escalation: If the applicable safe steps fail, preserve the results and contact the service team.

kb.title: VPN 5.0 known idle disconnect
kb.tags: vpn 5.0 idle 15 minutes 断开
steps: Save work, then install the approved VPN 5.1 update from the managed Software Center.
Reconnect and observe for at least 20 minutes.
kb.verification: VPN stays connected for at least 20 minutes.
kb.escalation: If the applicable safe steps fail, preserve the results and contact the service team.

kb.title: VPN local network instability
kb.tags: vpn wifi internet unstable 网络
steps: Move closer to the access point or test an approved wired connection.
Reconnect VPN and compare with the previous network.
kb.escalation: If the applicable safe steps fail, preserve the results and contact the service team.

kb.title: VPN gateway outage
kb.tags: vpn gateway outage 故障
conditions: An active matching VPN incident exists
steps: Check the current service incident and affected region.
Use only work resources already accessible without VPN while awaiting recovery.
kb.verification: Service status recovers and employee confirms access.
kb.escalation: If the applicable safe steps fail, preserve the results and contact the service team.

kb.title: VPN authentication rejected
kb.tags: vpn authentication login 登录
steps: Check the exact non-secret error and whether Okta sign-in works.
If Okta also fails, follow the account runbook rather than reinstalling VPN.
kb.escalation: If the applicable safe steps fail, preserve the results and contact the service team.

kb.title: Differentiate login failure
kb.tags: okta login password 登录 密码
steps: Record the non-secret error and whether the user reaches the MFA step.
Check current Okta health before asking the employee to repeat a reset.
kb.escalation: If the applicable safe steps fail, preserve the results and contact the service team.

kb.title: Forgotten password self-service
kb.tags: okta password reset 密码 重置
conditions: No reset already tried without success
steps: Open the company-managed Okta sign-in bookmark and choose the self-service password reset option.
Use only the recovery channel already registered in the directory. Never share codes in chat.
kb.escalation: If the applicable safe steps fail, preserve the results and contact the service team.

kb.title: Repeated reset did not help
kb.tags: okta reset failed locked 重置 失败
steps: Do not repeat a failed password reset. Record the error and whether MFA is reached.
Ask Identity Support to inspect lockout or recovery policy if status is healthy.
kb.verification: Identity Support verifies recovery; employee confirms sign-in.
kb.escalation: If the applicable safe steps fail, preserve the results and contact the service team.

kb.title: Lost MFA device
kb.tags: okta mfa lost 手机 丢失
steps: Do not approve new MFA prompts or share recovery codes.
Request Identity Support identity verification and MFA recovery.
kb.escalation: If the applicable safe steps fail, preserve the results and contact the service team.

kb.title: Unexpected MFA prompts
kb.tags: okta security suspicious mfa 安全
steps: Decline unexpected prompts and stop trying to approve them.
Contact Security using the configured handoff; do not share passwords.
kb.escalation: If the applicable safe steps fail, preserve the results and contact the service team.

kb.title: Chicago shared latency
kb.tags: salesforce slow chicago 慢 芝加哥
steps: Check regional Salesforce status and whether coworkers are affected.
If a matching incident exists, link it and avoid repeated local resets.
kb.verification: Incident recovery and normal loading confirmed.
kb.escalation: If the applicable safe steps fail, preserve the results and contact the service team.

kb.title: Single browser loading issue
kb.tags: salesforce browser cache loading 浏览器
steps: Save work and test the managed browser private window.
If only one browser is affected, record its version and extension list without exporting private data.
kb.escalation: If the applicable safe steps fail, preserve the results and contact the service team.

kb.title: Production access approval
kb.tags: snowflake production access 权限 生产
steps: Check current entitlements and department.
Submit a least-privilege approval request with business justification; do not grant access directly.
kb.verification: Owner approval and subsequent provisioning confirmed.
kb.escalation: If the applicable safe steps fail, preserve the results and contact the service team.

kb.title: Dashboard access request
kb.tags: grafana dashboard permission 权限 看板
steps: Check existing viewer entitlement.
Request viewer access with the dashboard scope and business justification if missing.
kb.verification: Approved access and dashboard loading confirmed.
kb.escalation: If the applicable safe steps fail, preserve the results and contact the service team.

kb.title: Pipeline timeout after maintenance
kb.tags: jenkins timeout maintenance pipeline 超时 维护
steps: Collect job name, first failure timestamp and non-secret error.
Compare recent network changes and Snowflake connectivity; do not rerun destructive jobs or roll back production.
kb.verification: Platform team verifies dependencies and a successful safe job run.
kb.escalation: If the applicable safe steps fail, preserve the results and contact the service team.

kb.title: Stale downstream reports
kb.tags: tableau stale refresh report 报表
steps: Check latest successful refresh and upstream job status.
Correlate failures with Jenkins; do not assume the report itself is the root cause.
kb.verification: Upstream recovery and successful refresh confirmed.
kb.escalation: If the applicable safe steps fail, preserve the results and contact the service team.

kb.title: Office Wi-Fi connectivity
kb.tags: wifi network 连接 无线
steps: Check whether other devices or coworkers on the same network are affected.
Use an approved wired connection if available and report the location.
kb.escalation: If the applicable safe steps fail, preserve the results and contact the service team.

kb.title: Mail delivery delay
kb.tags: email mail outlook 邮件
steps: Check mail service health and whether multiple recipients are affected.
Record the non-secret error and time; never paste mail bodies containing sensitive data.
kb.escalation: If the applicable safe steps fail, preserve the results and contact the service team.

kb.title: Managed laptop startup
kb.tags: laptop startup hardware 笔记本 开机
steps: Check power connection and visible indicator lights.
For overheating, swelling or damage, stop use and contact Hardware Support.
kb.verification: Hardware team or employee confirms safe operation.
kb.escalation: If the applicable safe steps fail, preserve the results and contact the service team.

kb.title: Meeting audio issue
kb.tags: teams audio meeting 麦克风
steps: Check selected input/output in the managed meeting client.
Test with the built-in audio test without recording confidential meetings.
kb.escalation: If the applicable safe steps fail, preserve the results and contact the service team.

kb.title: Deprecated VPN workaround
kb.tags: vpn disable firewall legacy
steps: Do not use: obsolete workaround.
kb.escalation: If the applicable safe steps fail, preserve the results and contact the service team.

kb.title: Query performance triage
kb.tags: snowflake slow query 慢
steps: Record query ID without pasting customer data.
Compare service status and route warehouse configuration changes to Data Platform.
kb.escalation: If the applicable safe steps fail, preserve the results and contact the service team.

rules.rule: Self only; server injects employee identity.
Registered recovery channel required for reset.
Every reset/access request requires exact confirmation.
Production access requires owner approval; never directly grant.
MFA recovery requires human identity verification.
No production rollback, shell, SQL or firewall modification tool.
History is advisory; current policy/status takes precedence.
Reset does not imply successful employee login.
Handoff queue is simulated and not staffed.
